supported_claims: With two identical rows per independent latent group, rowwise leave-one-out leaks the group label to the memorizer and has exact zero Brier loss.
Group heldout leave-one-group-out shows the memorizer's exact Brier loss 1/4.
Global Laplace group versus row heldout expectations are derived independently for three known Bernoulli p values.
limitations: Only artificial binary group latent worlds; no independent human experimental evaluation.
Rowwise versus groupwise predictions use different training row counts; the difference has no unique causal leakage attribution for every model.
No postselection external risk, unseen historical forecasting, or PESEN promotion established.
